title: Vapir One V5.0 Starter Kit (taxes included)
description:
PHASED OUT, CURRENT VAPIR MODELS:
VAPIR NO2 V2.0 PORTABLE VAPORIZER
VAPIRRISE 2.0 DESKTOP VAPORIZER
VAPIR PRIMA PORTABLE VAPORIZER

Everything you love about the Vapir One with an upgraded fan.

New features to V5.0:
Stronger more durable fan
More insulation to help prevent leaking

Features:
– Supercharged Heater
– Silicon Ring Sealed Top
– Digital Temperature Control
– Celsius and Fahrenheit
– up to 204 degrees C (400F)
– Forced Air Vaporizer
– Fan Speed Control
– Tube or Bag
– Includes 5 Large Bags
– 3 Partial Solid Disks & 1 X-Tip
– Corded Vaporizer (8 foot cord)
– Compact Design
– Vaporizers.ca Tip Sheet
– 90 Day Warranty
– 110V only (North America)
– Unit Weight: 1.2 lb / 0.54 kg
– Unit Dimensions: 8.5″H * 7″L * 2.5″W
– Shipping Box Dimensions (plain brown): 4.5″H * 12″L * 10″W
$149.95 USD

Starter Kit Also Includes:
– 2 Large Bags (5 large bags also included with unit)
– 2 X Tips
– 2 Tubes
– 3 Partial Solid Disks
– 2 H20 Tool
– 1 Extra Jaguar Aroma Disks

5.0 Kit available for $169.95 USD

Heat Up Time (from cold):
250F/120C – up to 60 seconds
365F/185C – up to 2 minutes
* Even faster heat up times if still warm from previous use*
